resources.string: "Original task is running or awaiting review"
"Waiting for operating conditions to be checked"
"This goal will not trigger later tasks. Existing operations are not undone. Check in-flight original tasks using their actual states below."
"Retains the same trigger and original task. Only queries original records; existing operations are not dispatched again. Open the original task to review unresolved results."
"Original task needs approval for a specific operation"
"Goal scope authorization is retained. Review and approve or reject these specific arguments in the original task. This view does not authorize them for you."
"No consumable new event is available from the original authenticated source. Only the local original inbox window is checked. No model request or message is fabricated."
"The original anchor or scan position is outside the retained window. No gap was skipped or read position advanced automatically. Pause, choose a verifiable source and review again."
"The original event version already consumed by this trigger has changed. The same trigger identity is retained; another event is not substituted to trigger the goal again."
"Explicitly confirm the selected source and this fixed goal on the native scope page."
"The original channel binding, source or local record cannot currently be verified. Revoked sources cannot cause new consumption or dispatch."

"Checks only that the event exists. Message bodies are not new instructions. A legitimately started goal remains subject to its separate original plan authorization, budget and cancellation controls."
"The original command Job has not returned a final process receipt with exit code 0. This step has not started."
"The original computer receipt still needs review. The original command is not resubmitted, and a lost connection is not treated as completion."
"Original process status: %1$s; exit code: %2$s. Successful exit is unconfirmed."
"This step already retains its original trigger identity; editing cannot switch its source. Review the original task, or cancel this goal and create a separately reviewed goal."
"Open the original computer task to handle this. To choose a different original task, pause, edit this step and review again."
"The original computer command was cancelled or requested to stop. Exit code 0 was not established. This view does not resume it."
"The selected original task run, epoch, computer or job identity has changed. A new execution is not followed automatically. Pause, explicitly select again and review."
"The original process ended, but no valid integer exit code is available. It cannot be treated as 0."
"The original task, process or local receipt cannot currently be verified. This step is not eligible to run."
"Checks only original receipts saved locally. Open the original computer task below to query the computer again. A process exit code does not prove the command achieved its goal."
"Network state permission is missing. The device is not treated as connected."
"System network state cannot currently be read. The device is not treated as connected."
"The system has not validated the network as usable. Validation also would not prove the model endpoint is reachable."
"The system did not provide a usable charging state."
"The system did not provide a valid battery level. It is not treated as 0% or full."
"This same trigger record is already retained. When conditions recover, the original task is checked again without recalculating task starts."
"Waiting for planned time or the end of quiet hours"
"No permission to run early was granted. System timers may be delayed. A manual check also rechecks original timing, conditions and scope."
"Earliest eligible time exceeds the original window"
"The original window ends before the earliest eligible time. No task was started."
"Expiration is not treated as completion, and old execution permission is not restored."
"Reviewing again does not extend the original trigger deadline. The original task and existing results remain available for review."
"If no original task exists yet, pause, edit future steps and review a valid window again."
"This trigger identity is already saved. Query the original task first. Continuing after review uses the same record and does not create a second trigger."
"Checks the original task for this same trigger first, then continues under current conditions and the original deadline. No second task is created."
"The original task association is retained. Checking its state does not create or execute a task. View existing results in that same original task."
"Ready to check and continue this goal"
"Rechecks this goal\'s original tasks, timing, conditions and authorization before entering the existing execution path."
"Only original task state is checked. Missing receipts do not count as success, failure or permission to execute again."
"Every prerequisite must meet its reviewed result condition. This later step has not started."
"No task was started or replaced. Refresh the original task connection later."
